items.quote: The experimental part of this study consisted of 1) microstructure observation by using EPMA, SEM and XRD, 2) liquidus and solidus measurements by a high-speed pyrometry (Pyroskop KGA 840, KLEIBER® infrared GmbH, Germany), 3) thermodynamic parameters of Re-Zr system by CALPHAD method.
The starting Re and Zr elements of purity no less than 99.98% were obtained from Beijing Innochem Science and Technology Co. Ltd., China.

One part was kept for the as-cast microstructure observation, one part was annealed at 1223 K for 90 days, and the others were multiple annealing (annealed at 1773 K for 72 h, and then annealed at 1373 K for 21 days).
